Gulf-front in Blue Mountain Beach!

50 steps to beach (private access)

Complimentary (seasonal) beach chairs & umbrella!

Community beachfront pool!

3 bedroom, 3 baths

4 bikes

4-star restaurants

Fun and yummy shops

Pappy Hour by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Welcome to Pappy Hour, a beautiful 3 bedroom, 3 bathroom vacation condo in picturesque Blue Mountain Beach. Enjoy complimentary beach chair service from March – October. You’ll receive two chairs, and one beach umbrella set up each morning. Four bikes are complimentary as well! The gated community is one block south of 30A between two non-renting communities, offering the perfect blend of quiet beauty and access to all the conveniences, including a beach-front pool! The hot tub, gas grilling area, basketball goal, and beach access are also just steps away. Also included is a covered garage parking spot, an additional parking lot, and an elevator, inside.

Prefer a work-out in the onsite gym, then a walk on the beach? Go for it. Inside, the spacious, newly renovated unit has a comfortable and stylish interior. The open living space and 400-square-foot balcony showcase the incredible Gulf of Mexico. Beautiful! Staying in for the night? After enjoying the sunset from your balcony, watch a movie on the new 80" Smart TV. Plus, many of the nearby eateries offer take-out. Or simply use the full kitchen. The primary suite, king, features a bathroom with an oversized jacuzzi tub, walk-in shower, 60" Smart TV, and private balcony with lounge chairs. Additional bedrooms on the opposite side of the unit include a king bed ensuite with main balcony access in one, and full-over-full bunk beds, with trundle, in the other, each with TVs. The beautiful beaches of 30A are featured every year on the list of top beaches in the country! You’ll be within a ten-minute walk to several fantastic restaurants, ice cream, a bakery, a health food store and even live music. You’re going to love it! Welcome! Our dedicated team at Oversee 30A, a local company, is committed to ensuring your stay is nothing short of exceptional. We strive for perfection and are just a stone's throw away should you require any assistance. Reach out to us anytime, seven days a week, with the added peace of a 24/7 emergency line. Overview: - Gulf-front - 50 steps to beach (private access) - 3 bedrooms, 3 baths - 4 bikes - 1618 sq ft - Community gulf-front pool - Complimentary beach service (seasonal March 1st- October 31st) - Parking in the garage is limited to 1 vehicle, but overflow parking is available outside of the garage. - Wi-Fi Overnight: - King in primary bedroom; private bath; TV - King in primary bedroom; private bath; TV - Full/full bed in guest bunk room; hall bath; TV Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Checkout is 10:00 AM CST.
